answer: We define a decentralized protocol wherein a cryptographic beacon dictates epoch-based zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions to secure staking collateral. By routing verification through a timber partition of multi-asset bonds and a cedar architecture for slashing penalties, the expected utility of identity multiplication is strictly negative. Under these dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, the subgame-perfect punishment matrix forces any Sybil deviation into a dominant-strategy loss, establishing a unique and robust Nash equilibrium.
